name: Banner
description: Mortar banner: a site-wide announcement bar with an optional link and dismiss button, in the inverse or default tone.

props.children:
ReactNode (phrasing only: text, links and emphasis; rendered inside a

, so no block elements such as

,

or headings)
props.label: string
props.tone: "default" | "inverse" | "accent" (default "inverse"; accent paints the brand's accent fill, its gradient when it defines one, with on-accent text)
props.variant: "bar" | "floating" (default "bar"; floating is an inset, rounded panel with a shadow)
props.placement: "inline" | "bottom" (default "inline"; bottom fixes the banner to the bottom of the viewport and always shows the dismiss button, which hides it even when onDismiss is omitted)

contract.usage: Import { Banner } from @tonycodes-ui/mortar. Pass phrasing content as children (a short announcement, optionally with a link). For a full marketing section, use Section.
contract.avoid:
Do not put block elements (

contract.accessibility: Verify accessible names, keyboard interaction, visible focus, responsive layout and supported states. The banner is a region named by label. Dismissing it moves focus to the next control. A bottom banner can always be dismissed, so it never covers page content for good.
